test_title: PYST 48: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K and L are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only two people sit between L and J. Only J sits to the right of D. Only three people sit between D and C. K sits at some place to the left of B but at some place to the right of I. How many people sit between I and B?7073
solution:
Given: Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K and L are sitting in a straight line facing north.

Only two people sit between L and J.

Only J sits to the right of D.

Only three people sit between D and C.

K sits somewhere to the left of B but to the right of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/454a2f1f7318a0aa5ab554c3b794c8a18da6c3570b5d92069b15fda8e74a3b21.png] 

So, there are 3 people between I and B.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
